name: PhysEditWorld
summary: 通过在相同场景、初态和动作序列下改变重力参数生成的物理规则可编辑世界模型数据集。
summaryEn: A physics-editable world-model dataset generated by varying gravity while holding scenes, initial states, and action sequences fixed.
scaleZh: 超过 100 小时、超过 6,000 万轨迹帧
license: See ModelScope dataset and asset terms
licenseZh: 见 ModelScope 数据集和素材条款
accessZh: ModelScope 提供公开数据入口
verdict: 利用配对反事实轨迹研究可编辑物理规律的数据集
verdictEn: Paired counterfactual rollouts for studying editable physical laws
wmNote: 控制其他因素并改变重力，有利于物理因果和反事实预测。
wmNoteEn: Changing gravity while controlling other factors supports physical-causal and counterfactual prediction.

evidence.sourceTitle: [2606.26694] PhysEditWorld: A Large-Scale Dataset Toward Physics-Editable World Models
evidence.statement: Matched initial states and action traces are replayed under different gravity values with synchronized engine state and observations.
